description: Fork of exp588 (1.4344 SoTA, single read_out_lut H=1 tph=1536 -> D=384). SINGLE change: read_out_lut becomes multi-head: n_heads=6, n_outputs=64 (per head), tables_per_head=256, NAP=6. Output [B*T, 6, 64] reshaped to [B*T, 384] (concat heads) -> ln_final(D) -> Linear(D, V). NOT param/bandwidth matched to exp588 — sharp 6x reduction in read_out_lut params (37.7M -> 6.29M) and bandwidth (18.87 Mbits -> 3.15 Mbits). Tests whether 6 specialised 64-dim head readouts capture enough independent structure to match the single big read_out. Total ~248.6M params, ~139 Mbits trunk, ~542 Mbits total. Win => significant bandwidth reduction at no quality cost. Loss => single deep read_out (K=64 rows × tph=1536) was load-bearing capacity.
